moderationRules.title: Moderation Rules
moderationRules.introBody: Before submitting a moderator access request, users must read and accept the moderation rules. These rules help ensure the accuracy, quality, and safety of content on the platform.
moderationRules.footnote: *By submitting a request, you confirm that you agree with all of the above conditions.

role.title: Role of the Moderator
role.body: The moderator is responsible for preserving the quality, accuracy, and reliability of content on the platform. Moderators are expected to act impartially, responsibly, and in the best interest of the user community.

obligations.title: Moderator Responsibilities
obligations.body: The moderator must verify the accuracy of information before publishing or editing, update inaccurate or outdated data, use appropriate and professional communication, and report content that may be harmful, false, or inappropriate.

allowed.title: Allowed Activities
allowed.body: A moderator may add verified information, correct existing data, improve the descriptions of locations, events, and places, and contribute to better organization and higher content quality across the platform.

forbidden.title: Prohibited Activities
forbidden.body: A moderator must not submit false or unverified information, abuse moderation privileges for personal gain, favor their own content or known businesses, change valid content without cause, or publish offensive, discriminatory, or misleading content.

standards.title: Content Standards
standards.body: All submitted data must be accurate, clear, up to date, and useful. Names, descriptions, categories, addresses, locations, and photos must be relevant and trustworthy. Content must not mislead users.

fairness.title: Responsibility and Impartiality
fairness.body: A moderator is required to act objectively and avoid conflicts of interest. Personal, business, or promotional interests must not influence decisions about content and edits on the platform.

penalties.title: Consequences of Violations
penalties.body: Violating the moderation rules may result in a warning, temporary restriction of moderator privileges, permanent removal of moderator access, or additional administrative review of the account.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of the Rules
acceptance.body: By submitting a moderator access request, the user confirms that they have read, understood, and accepted the moderation rules and that they will follow them while using the platform.

1.q: How do I update my profile information?
1.a: You can edit your information on the Profile screen in the Edit profile section or on the Settings screen in the Edit profile section. There you can change your first name, last name, phone number, country, profile photo, as well as your password.

2.q: Where can I see my favorite items?
2.a: Favorite destinations, places, and other saved content are located on the Favorites screen, where you can view or remove them.

3.q: How does the trip planner work?
3.a: The planner allows you to save events you want to attend during your trip and reminds you about them.

4.q: How do I change the application language?
4.a: You can change the application language on the Settings screen in the Language section. After selecting a language, the change will appear immediately in the application.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.heroBody: Your privacy and data security are important to us. On this page, you can learn which information the application displays, how it is used, and how it helps improve your travel experience.

1.title: Account data
1.body: SpireGO may display basic account information such as your name, email address, profile photo, and profile settings in order to personalize your experience in the application.

2.title: Locally stored data
2.body: Certain data, such as travel plans, favorite destinations, or application settings, may be temporarily stored on your device for faster and easier use of the application.

3.title: How to contact us
3.body: Certain data, such as travel plans, favorite destinations, or application settings, may be temporarily stored on your device for faster and easier use of the application.

note.1: Your data is used exclusively for the application's functionality and for improving the user experience.
note.2: We strive to ensure that your information is protected and accessible only to you.
note.3: Some features may require additional identity verification for account security.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.heroTitle: Rules and guidelines for using the application.
terms.heroBody: By using the SpireGO application, you accept the basic rules of use, data protection principles, and the responsible use of the available features.

1.title: Using the application
1.body: SpireGO allows users to browse destinations, places, events, favorites, and personalized content. The user is responsible for the accuracy of the information they enter and use within their account.

2.title: Content and information
2.body: We strive to keep the information in the application accurate and up to date, but content availability may depend on external services and data sources. Some information may be changed or temporarily unavailable.

3.title: Account and security
3.body: The user is responsible for the security of their account and the confidentiality of their login credentials. We recommend using strong passwords and regularly updating account information.

note.1: Favorites, reviews, and settings are linked to your user account.
note.2: Certain data may be temporarily stored locally on your device to improve the user experience.
note.3: By using the application, you accept future improvements and changes to the system's functionality.
